verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites checkpoint themselves while an agent works and can roll back to any checkpoint in seconds. That gives a first-party form of versioning and rollback for the environment where agent automations run, but it is environment snapshots rather than explicit automation versioning. missing for 10: explicit versioning of automation definitions, any review or diff workflow before changes go live, detailed docs on how checkpoints are listed, compared and managed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.
Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds
